name: GetSelectedCellRangeFromExcelWorksheetNode
label: Get Selected Cell Range from Excel Worksheet
description: Gets the address and details of the currently selected cell range in an Excel worksheet.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: WorksheetInstance
fields.label: Worksheet Instance
fields.description: The Excel Worksheet from which to get the selected range.

fields.name: SelectedRangeAddress
fields.label: Selected Range Address
fields.description: The address of the currently selected range (e.g., '$A$1:$C$5').

fields.name: StartRow
fields.label: Start Row
fields.description: The starting row of the selection.

fields.name: StartColumn
fields.label: Start Column
fields.description: The starting column number of the selection.

fields.name: EndRow
fields.label: End Row
fields.description: The ending row of the selection.

fields.name: EndColumn
fields.label: End Column
fields.description: The ending column number of the selection.

fields.name: RowCount
fields.label: Row Count
fields.description: The number of rows in the selection.

fields.name: ColumnCount
fields.label: Column Count
fields.description: The number of columns in the selection.
